Completed implementation of the tokyo-night theme:
- Added standalone static/themes/tokyo-night.css based on Antharchy/Omarchy tokyo-night color palette.
- Added 'tokyo-night' to AVAILABLE_THEMES in markusmd.themes.
- Added [data-theme="tokyo-night"] styles to static/markus.css.
- Added BDD feature scenarios in features/themes.feature and updated features/site.feature.
- Verified with behave (all 67 scenarios passing) and ruff lint.
